proposal.diagnosis: Calling `.lean()` on `findById(userId)` returns a plain JavaScript object without model instance methods like `toPublicProfile()`. This causes callers such as `userProfileService.getPublicProfile` to throw a runtime error when invoking instance methods.
proposal.strategy: Revert the `.lean()` call so `getUser` returns the full model instance with its methods intact.
proposal.intentNote: Reverting `.lean()` undoes the optimization to ensure User model instance methods such as `toPublicProfile` remain accessible to consumers.
